messages:
sam: Kicking off a staged rollout for redwood-api v2.3.1 -> target 15% over 20m. Change window 13:00-15:00 PST. Routing by user-id hash. deploy-bot: scheduling rollout: 5% now, ramp to 15% over 20m. deploy-bot: tracker https://deploys.example.com/rollouts/1767001111
maria: quick checklist: fallback image pinned? healthchecks enabled? rollback trigger = error_rate>0.5% for 5m?
alex: healthchecks = readiness+latency SLOs. fallback is v2.2.9, not pinned by default. recommend we pin fallback before we go full 15%.
taylor-oncall: seeing slight blip of 502s in eu-west on the first minute (0.34% -> 0.8%). Not sure if noise. watching.
maria: ok changing plan: reduce initial to 2% while we validate eu-west telemetry. If error_rate>0.5% for 3m -> divert to fallback. Also limit new sessions to 1 per second on the canary nodes.
sam: acknowledged. deploy-bot, set weight to 2% now.
deploy-bot: executing: set-weight redwood-api v2.3.1 2% -> in progress... done. New weights propagated to edge.
taylor-oncall: error spike peaked then trended down to 0.2% after traffic throttle. looks correlated with a particular host pool. tagging infra to investigate: @infra
alex: if infra needs a quick kill we can route text-gen to v2.2.9 only and leave embeddings on v2.3.1 — lower blast radius.
maria: good idea. prepare commands:
```
routedctl set-weight redwood-api text-gen v2.2.9 100
routedctl set-weight redwood-api embeddings v2.3.1 100
```
sam: for now keep L1:2% traffic and run 10m stability window. If stable -> ramp to 5% in 10m. Anyone object?
taylor-oncall: +1 after observed drop; will escalate immediately iff >0.5% sustained
maria: release notes updated with the fallback plan and the change window. I've added the rollback commands to the runbook.
sam: consensus is to proceed with cautious ramp (2% -> 5% after 10m). Closing thread for now — please reopen if metrics fail or infra asks for full rollback. :white_check_mark:
